sentences: Dimension expansion asks whether applying several linear maps makes every relevant subspace grow in dimension.
The source asks for the computational complexity of evaluating this expansion.
Unlike ordinary vertex expansion, the objects being expanded form a continuous family of subspaces.
An efficient method would help assess algebraic expanders and the rank-condensation constructions that produce them.
